U.note: Clean iOS-style calculator with expression line, grouped digits, clear zero message, aria-live and keyboard; complete and not overbuilt.

V.note: Tidy dark basic calculator with correct results and divide-by-zero message; plain look and small text on long numbers but solid.

W.note: Striking seven-segment pocket calculator with tactile keys and backspace; 8-digit cap and Error display are authentic, though the styling adds code weight.

X.note: Dark orange iOS-like calculator that works well; shows only 'Error' on divide by zero and the 0 key label sits left, slightly less polished.

Y.note: Attractive retro LCD design, but the history panel and extra Backspace bar overbuild a basic calculator and add the most code.

Z.note: Polished dark blue-accent calculator with expression line, backspace, clear Error state and good phone layout; thin key labels slightly low contrast.
